rule.nominal: Compute unchanged P4 nominal steering/gas/brake once. Gas and brake must be mutually exclusive.
rule.choice: Let q0 be the active nominal float32 pedal. Among finite float32 q in[0,q0], choose the largest q whose ORIGINAL first20ms per-wheel force equations satisfy sqrt(F_long(q)^2+F_lat^2)<=current per-wheel friction limit for all wheels. The inactive pedal stays0; q0=0 has only q=0.
rule.current_inputs_only: Current native/model wheel local velocity/omega/appliedgas/brake/joint/contact/grip and original source constants; never cached future raw force or failure-position/time.
rule.force_map: Original one-call rear gas+0.1 ramp, engine omega update, brake omega update and current wheel-frame demand. No world.Step or simulated transition in the allocator.
rule.no_monotonicity_assumption: Gas ramp/rolling-longitudinal sign and brake clamp are piecewise; intersect feasible intervals, quantize actual dispatched pedal and recheck original equations. Do not assume q=0 feasible.
rule.quantization: Optimization domain is the finite float32 dispatched active pedal, not a possibly open real-lambda supremum. If maximal feasible command cannot be certified, technical/domain stop. No arbitrary epsilon or threshold relaxation.

brake_branch_proof.proof: effective_mass*brake_accel/(4*1.6*15/(.02*.54))=0.3; q<=q0 excludes0.9 lock branch for this fixed model only

rule.infeasible: Empty certified set stops that arm with state/domain evidence; no neutral/guardian rescue.
rule.scope: First raw tick conditional algebraic feasibility only; does not certify all4rawticks/80ms or restore feasibility when lateral demand alone is excessive.

preregistered_gates: Saved full-before wheel-state/command→stored first-raw force reconstruction under existing source; no new physics. Missing source fields or mismatch closes the gate.
q=q0 identity whenever nominal is certified feasible; only gas/brake magnitude may change; steering/node/phase/memory boundary and current-input causality remain exact.
Boundary, finite/zero, ramp, rolling sign, brake clamp and float32 quantization tests. No source-equation fit, parameter sweep or failure-location trigger.
Fresh source35 +Original/oldP4/newP4 H13 independent2+held each +new pending pair/held; all counted in future budget. No physics before revised source/space/time gates.

Two fixed-root model whole arms once each, oldP4 vsallocatorP4, max250actions each. Exact own H13 prefix before14; raw unsafe/progress/domain closes arm, technical/source/numeric stops all; no in-run repair or rescue.

pass_and_stop.mechanism: Report every joint/slip/force/time change and counterexample; lower clipping alone does not pass.
pass_and_stop.whole: Candidate must have its own safe model finish before further transfer. If both finish, report paired finish brackets; if baseline is unsafe report safety recovery only, never fabricate baseline finish or full time gain.
pass_and_stop.negative: No command change, invalid algebra, ineligibility, unsafe/domain/censor or no safe own finish closes this one candidate; do not retune a coefficient or add a pulse.
pass_and_stop.promotion: No native, pixel, HOLDOUT/SEALED or generalization promotion from this analysis/model screen. Native requires a separate complete contract; current native storage forecasts fail.
